english: You approach the mirror, realizing that Viira is watching you quite closely.
But taking a quick glance, you do see: there is surely a hidden safe behind this mirror.
E-Interesting. I'll have to come back when Viira isn't around.
You check behind the mirror. There's a safe in the wall.
Careful, Cleric, the goblin whispers to you.
The Freestriders are many things, but careless is not one of them.
Meek has tip!
(Inspect the safe.)
Crack the safe.
E-Time to go.
Yes! Tip!
Your scarf drags you to the left, forcing you to look at the fireplace.
Ugly smoke is watching. Beware...
I am aware, Meek, but thank you.
Thank you for pointing that out Meek. That's very helpful.
Good! Of course master is aware. Master is always aware...
Meek is happy to help!
Old design. Arcane Era.
Simple mechanism, built upon entering an esoterically attuned iron piece.
Looks like you need a key.
Thick walls. A handle. The words, 'Orion & Glott' are hammered into the front plate.
This would be difficult to get into without the proper tools.
Try sticking your fingers into that key hole.
You want to crack the safe, right?
You see a pair of glittering eyes watching you.
You glance towards the flames. The mephit is clearly avoiding looking in your direction.
Tracing the rim of the key hole with your gloved fingers, you sense the esoterically aligned arcane power within.
It sends tingles up your entire arm.
You bring out the lockpick. Using it to explore the mechanism inside.
Being careful not to trigger the magical barrier inside, you realize by exploring that the rim inside has a dead zone.
A tiny gap where the spell (enchantment of some kind?) does not reach.
(Press against that gap while fiddling with the mechanism.)
You do so, and within seconds you hear a click.
Whatever you did, it just worked!
I am the greatest! A true rogue for the era.
That was lucky.
(Just look inside.)
You sure are.
Luck is just another word for intent-less skill.
You lean in.
Damn. Great job. Seriously.
And since the mephit is dead, it won't stop you this time...
An esoteric force causes you to shiver, as you realize there's a shrill voice hissing at you from behind.
You hear a mephit whistling in his fire.
I ain't seeing nothing here, no sir.
You fumble around the handle and the hole.
Come on.
A gloved finger can just barely fit inside.
Come ON.
(Try the handle.)
Please open up?
(Stick a finger in the hole.)
It's firm and stiff.
Oh, you know it baby.
It won't budge without the hole being filled.
No response.
You know what to do.
As you do, instantly your entire arm jolts back.
A great overwhelming sensation of dread comes over you.
You are SEEN.
Luckily, there is no mephit to SEE you this time.
Guess you gotta try again, later.
You hear a mephit cackling in his fire.
You say the words and wave your hand in front of the safe.
As you do, a loud crackling bang fills your ears.
Loud enough to echo out into the cave ceiling outside.
It might be loud, but no one probably cares.
The goblin is holding his ears down.
You want to wake all of Waterlane? Geez.
Good thing the mephit's gone.
Shit. You should get out of here. But first...
You hear the mephit swearing to itself.
Way too loud. You idiot.
But crit it. I didn't hear shit. Guess I'm deaf.
As the door glides open soundlessly, you see inside a stack of papers bound by a leather strap.
(Grab the orange ledger.)
As you do, you realize how light it is.
Is this... just one paper? Two?
What the hell? Why would they keep a single contract alone in a safe?
It must be juicy.
You look over the text real quick.
It's easy enough to understand what it means.
The contract is between the Askanii-Reeds Trade Company, and the City of Norvik.
What's taking so long?
What's it about?
Can't this wait?
Fine. Be quick.
No.

The contract states that 'From the 1st of Beltan, on the morrow of the Bloodnight,' (that is four days after the election), 'the land rights of 15 collective ports across Norvik will be transferred to...'

The contract states that 'From the 1st of Beltan, on the morrow of the Bloodnight,' (that is a month after the election), 'the land rights of 15 collective ports across Norvik will be transferred to...'
A bunch of company names you've never heard of - then there's...
Huh. The signatures of those businesses. They're all...
Magistrates.
One of them says 'Nicholas Darrow'.
They're doing what?
He scans the pages.
That's... insane.
If the people knew... there would be panic.
The election is a SHAM.
Genius move, honestly. This means the Freestriders will get control of the city, no matter what happens on election day.
And the Magistrates will all get rich!
Oh, they're good.
Now that you've got this info, you better get out of here. But, uh...
These fucking Freestriders...
Should I release this somehow?
E-Right. Time to get out of here.
I honestly have no idea. All I know is that... you and me? We are NOT supposed to see this shit.
So don't do anything hasty.
Perhaps.
Yes.
The folk needs to know the truth.
This is harmful for the city.
Pure corruption.
Eh.
You're not gonna stop it either way.
You should turn it in, back to Viira, later on. Tell her you got it from some thief on Waterlane.
You could make some friends with it.
And enemies. So... be careful who you show it to.
The city is corrupt. What a surprise.
Keep it, or share it. Make sure it does not trace back to you in either case.
Democracy in your grasp.
It festers.
It dies.
Hey, <shake>buddy</shake>!
Gods be fucking damned.
Time for you to get smoked!
Great line.
Balls.
Roll initiative.
This little shit...!
You're not getting away, you hear me?
Not for any moral reason - it's just my job to mess up critters with sticky fingers!
Shit.
Your companion looks around for something, and grabs a fire poker.
In the same motion he swings it at the small elemental, as if swatting a fly.
It dances around his first attack.
Whoa! Goblin's got teeth!
Get him! he barks order to you.
That's the plan, green guy.
Letting out a maniacal laugh, the mephit swoops in towards your face.
The poof of hot smoke burns your skin. And the inside of your nostrils.
Just barely dodging out of the way, the poof of hot smoke hits the wall.
The heat still stings.
Stand still! I'm not allowed to burn the wallpaper. I'm not allowed!
Intense pain follows.
Damn this beast. Vanquish it!
Beware! The beast is deadly and it frightens you.
But a decisive punch would be difficult to land, with the way it's flying about.
Grab it.
It will burn. But it will put a stop to it.
Do not grab it.
It will cause intense pain.
You could ask him nicely to stop? Maybe?
He's just following whatever contract he's signed.
There could be a loop-hole.
Come on, I wasn't doing anything that bad!
You can't just resort to violence like this!
Grab the mephit.
Punch the mephit.
Sure.
But you're still getting your skin seared off!
Are you kidding? This is the best part of the gig!
This freak. It's a monster that must be destroyed.
A monster. You shake.
You attempt to move forward, positioning your hands around the smokey beast.
Yet the pain - the heat - is too much.
It laughs at you.
Idiot!
With a decisive step, you move forward.
Your hip rotating.
Your entire body putting its weight into a single strike.
And it hits.
You attempt to step forward with a swing.
But the creature just dances around your arm, cackling.
Ga-haha! You really suck!
With a decisive step, you move forward, your hand channeling dark energies.
And it connects with the baffled elemental.
Its small smokey body, now filled with coursing necrotic power.
The necrotic energy flowing towards the creature - but it dances out of the way.
You're casting spells at me? Idiot!
It lets out another annoying cackle.
You ready for some fourth degree burns?!
Oh no, you don't...
He makes another swing with the poker.
Gah...! the smoke monster grunts as your companion smacks him across his entire body.
He got the fucker!
Great job, Snell!
Now, he should be an easy target!
Guh... take a deep breath, asshole!
A stream of smoke whirls your way.
Too slow. It hits you.
The heat is terrible.
A bit more ready for it - you dodge!
You feel a half second of relief.
Again. You must succeed.
You cannot allow this beast to remain material.
Break it!
Do you have a chance?
Take it. Take it!
Grab the mephit.
Punch the mephit.
This is embarrassing~!
Now die, will you?
Your companion takes a quick breath before diving in.
With a quick stab, the fire poker pierces through the elemental's body.
Gotcha!
Wha- no...!
With a shriek the elemental beast dissipates around the iron rod. Turning into... just smoke.
The elemental rushes towards you, and slips into the cracks in your helmet, and chain mail.
The heat it brings is unbearable.
This is your death.
Grab the mephit.
Punch the mephit.
As you pull back your fist, what remains in the smoke is...
Nothing.
You did it.
He sounds astonished.
I... did it.
With decisive movement you position yourself before the creature.
And clamp down on it.
What the crit?
Your hands burn.
Let me go...!
(Crush him harder.)
Guh...!
Through the gloves - your skin: seared.
Great, keep him like that!
(Crush him. One final time.)
No, no, noo...!
The elemental lets out a final cry as you put an incredible amount of pressure all around him.
And with a final squeeze...
It is gone.
Phew. Close one.
He drops the poker and leans up against the wall, coughing.
You okay?
Never been better.
Nice strike.
I didn't need your help.
Good. Then let's get outta here.
Sure was. First time I despawn an elemental. Crazy.
I beg to differ.
Die!
Cleric!
Your body falters.
You are... alone.
Live through the fire.
You hold it.
The PAIN.
The SUFFERING of this PURE FLAME ravaging your entire surface of SKIN.
This is...
It's NOTHING.
NOTHING.
NOTHING COMPARED TO THE PAIN YOU'VE FELT.
(Hug yourself.)
What - the - fuck?!
(Press harder.)
AAA - AHHH...!
The searing. The PAIN.
Within seconds, the entire surface of your SKIN is burnt to a crisp.
Where the creature was floating just a moment ago, you see a faint, tiny, ball of energy.
Not a soul. A mote.
And it disappears into nothingness.
But it's quickly gone from view.
I don't think elementals work like that.
Correct.
Right. It'll just respawn in the elemental plane. And such a minor elemental is unlikely to be returned here with its memory intact.
Let's hope. (Shrug.)
Oh. That's good.
Hm. Yeah.
Either way, we've got more important things to focus on.
Who knows?
No. Elementals that are destroyed will only phase into the elemental planes.
So it could return. But it is unlikely to do so. The chance of it witnessing against you is extremely minimal due to its minor nature.
There's a whole art of elemental magic you do not have much knowledge in. Perhaps in the future you will.
(Turn back to the safe.)
It's still there. As unlocked as it was a moment ago.
It stands there, ready for you.
It's still there- just as magically knocked-open as before.
